accepted_benchmark.scope: Deforming exterior-surface mesh backed by retained full volumetric tetrahedral topology; no native interactive full-volume tetrahedral visualization

particle_playback.scope: CPU worker versus synchronous semantic and buffer equivalence; headless is not image acceptance.

limitations: Exterior surface only; no interior-cell rendering or clipping
Unshaded material: normals validated numerically; no lighting claim
Callbacks/s is not monitor FPS; RSS samples are not whole-application peak memory; no VRAM attribution

timing.scope: Application callbacks, source-clock progress and process RSS; not monitor FPS or isolated GPU timing. Fixed 0.5 s warmup; OS page cache not flushed.

analysis_runtime.isolation: temporary venv with system site packages; no global install

harness_notes: Focused multi-view mesh tests use a plain background and skip unused sky filtering; the unchanged full benchmark native harness covers application inspection/source traces.
Native 04B source checks preceded cancellation-only and conservative GPU-quota hardening. Subsequent all-sample native mesh equivalence and G3 checks verify the same source/display behavior.

An earlier G3 run lacked the optional scikit-image runtime and full synthetic scene fixture; both were supplied in fresh local test data. Successful logs are retained; earlier exploratory outputs remain in the sibling run tree.

Raw timing callbacks use the aggregate mesh/field/particle underflow flag; the historical benchmark harness exposes only its original particle flag, so its incidental timing is not the PERF-003 underflow oracle.

benchmark_repository_integrity.scientific_evidence: Migrated files match pre-migration SHA-256 or declared operational replacements; newer packages match their registered retained inventory. Undownloaded external files are not validated.

acceptance.basis: Delivered mesh playback maintenance report and retained regression evidence using accepted Benchmark 04B
acceptance.scope: Move interactive deforming-mesh preparation off the playback-critical path while preserving topology, identity, vertex/cell associations, source values, units, load-factor semantics and renderer equivalence
acceptance.remaining_synchronous_work: GPU submission, explicit scientific inspection and some renderer/event-loop costs remain synchronous and outside PERF-003 scope
